title: Which AI Model Should You Actually Use?
description:
Most people pick their AI model by habit and use the same one all day. Claude and ChatGPT both ship a full lineup, and those tiers exist because the work is not all the same shape.

Everyday tasks. Quick answers, simple lookups. Haiku or GPT-5.6 Luna.
Common work. Emails, summaries, writing. Sonnet 5 or GPT-5.6 Terra. About 80% of your day is here.
Tough problems. Hard thinking, tricky bugs. Opus 5 or GPT-5.6 Sol.
Hardest only. Projects that run for days. Fable 5 or Sol at xhigh effort.

Running the top model for everything means paying for reasoning you did not need. Running the cheapest one on hard work means fixing it yourself afterward.

Match the model to the job.

Which one are you defaulting to?
